task.title: Independent B2 security review and Playwright/observation trace protected-surface remediation
task.objective: Independently review the B2 protected-capture remediation (f00143d7). Investigate whether Playwright failure traces (TraceService) and the default-on passive CDP observation trace (PassiveCdpTrace) persist protected-login surfaces; reproduce with synthetic fixtures; if confirmed, file a separate Beads security defect, add a verifier red against the vulnerable behaviour, and fix with the existing ProtectedSurfaceGuard: no chunk opened for protected-login/manual-handoff steps or while any context page is protected, per-frame navigation and new-page watch that stops and discards the chunk on a protected verdict or handoff, refusal of the save when the context fails the guard, observation samples proven clean before and after an in-memory capture. Restore the B2.5 per-capture diagnostic notes that regressed in f00143d7. Ordinary tracing and the protected-login handoff contract stay unchanged.

acceptance.description: The exposure is reproduced on the baseline with synthetic fixtures only: verify:trace-protected-capture 17 passed / 15 failed against f00143d7 (retained trace ZIPs held the protected DOM, frames, HTML body and a typed synthetic OTP); the observation sampler wrote screenshots, DOM samples and a live view of the protected page (O1 red under the guard-removed mutant).

No retained trace or observation sample holds a protected surface in onFailure, always and off modes (handoff cancelled/continued, title-first detection, undetected page, popup, iframe, transient page, iframe hop, self-closing popup, injected field), no chunk is opened when the surface is known before the step, recording stops before the operator acts on a handoff, ordinary traces and samples are kept, and each mechanism is load-bearing (mutation run 43/6).

verify:b2-protected-capture, verify:failure-evidence-live, verify:artifacts, verify:runner, verify:visual-isolation, verify:ai-fallback, verify:failure-capture-overhead, verify:mock-site, verify:verifier-classification and npm run build pass against the final state.
A fresh-context independent security review of the fix ends APPROVED; the B2 review verdict and residual risks are recorded.
A separate Beads security defect records the exposure and its remediation; KNOWN_ISSUES, SECURITY, CURRENT_STATE, HANDOFF and TASK_LOG are updated; the dashboard reports Sources agree.
